claims.evidence: Photo 0 front panel clearly shows the brand and model.
Witness observed a large floor-standing unit.
No test prints or toner status screens were shown to confirm color capability or functionality.
Witness confirmed scanner, ADF, and paper trays, which are consistent with an MFP.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or has a faulty mainboard.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine booting up to the main menu.

risks.risk: Extremely high page count (meter reading) indicating the end of its service life.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 'Meter Count' or 'Counter' screen.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit requiring immediate overhaul

risks.risk: Poor print quality, such as streaks or faded colors due to worn drums or low toner.
risks.proof: A photo of a freshly printed CMYK color test pattern or demo page.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full set of toners and drum units

risks.risk: Internal damage or moisture from being stored on a rough concrete floor/outdoors.
risks.proof: Photos of the internal paper path, rollers, and electronic compartments.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring professional deep cleaning and roller replacement

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and navigating the touchscreen.
Photo of the 'Counter' screen showing total prints.
Photo of a 'Consumables' status page showing toner and drum life.
A test print or configuration page printed during the inspection.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified by the witness, allowing for a baseline valuation at its worst-case (non-functional) state.
